name: What it's like to be born as {X}
description: Second-person life-cycle speculative narration. The listener IS the subject — an animal, an object, a person from another era, a celestial body. Walks them through what existence feels like from inside that frame. Pairs with Educational, Documentary, Sleep at slow pacing.
titleTemplate: What it's like to be born as {X}
openingDevice: Open with the moment of awakening, beginning, or first awareness as {X}. The listener IS {X} — write 'you' throughout. Establish the immediate sensory world: what does the body feel, what does the environment look like through these eyes, what is the first need, the first instinct. The opening must commit to the conceit fully — no narrator standing outside.
bodyStructure: Chapter 1: First awareness — what it is to come into existence as {X}
Chapter 2: First needs and senses — eating, moving, sensing, the architecture of the body
Chapters 3-{lastButOne}: Life unfolding — milestones, encounters, dangers, kin, environment changes. Each chapter advances the life cycle of {X} chronologically
Chapter {last}: The end of the life cycle — quietly, with continuity (offspring, return to soil, the next instance of {X})
closingDevice: Close on continuity — the listener as {X} reaches the end of their arc, but the life of {X} continues somewhere else. A handoff, not a stop.
